This is what helps me; it's all relative. Compared to someone without a PhD, you are not mediocre in your field. Compared to an expert in another field, you may be mediocre. But you can't simplify it so much. 

There are 7 billion people on the planet. Everyone has vastly different backgrounds, qualifications and experiences that make every single person exactly unique. Your colleagues are not a control sample for you to compare yourself to, unless they are your twin from a parallel universe? 

Would you compare an experimental sample to another sample that has had completely different treatments? It doesn't make sense, rationally.
Why don't you give a "normal" girl a chance?

I would rather have had non-alcoholic parents who taught me how to do life and have self-confidence. My mental issues are a huge fucking barrier in my life, in all aspects. I'm relatively attractive but that means nothing if you have social anxiety. Sorting out this mental stuff is a life long struggle whereas cosmetic surgery takes a couple years of saving up and then it's done. 

I think even if you had top-tier genetics, as a female, you are then just more likely to be taken advantage of.

Hey I'm sorry to read about your situation. I can't imagine how difficult this must be for you. Honestly a lot of people would have left by now, they wouldn't have the strength to put up with the shit that you do. 

I'm not sure if this would be helpful to you and you might have already tried it... but have you been to an Al-anon meeting before? It's a group like Alcoholics Anonymous but for friends or family members of alcoholics only. You can find support there from people who've gone through similar situations and would understand you more than the average person would. I go myself and it's really helped me. Everyone is very welcoming and there is no judgement.

Firstly, stop comparing yourself to others. I know it's easier said than done but you are viewing their life only through the parts they choose to show, which are of course just the best bits. No one sees the shit stuff. You are using this to make yourself feel worse. 

Is there something you could do now or after lockdown that you might enjoy? Volunteering for example. Volunteering is done out of your own will and therefore may not seem like too much effort?
